listing.name: Project TAILS
listing.summary: Adds a furry-themed portrait pack with AI-generated avatars, including a heavy metal variant with power armor and high-tech headwear.

description:
Introducing Project TAILS - Transformative Aerosols for Interspecies Lascivious Situations!

Download here!

Or here! (NexusMods mirror)

I wanted to see if I could spin up my own take on a furry portrait pack, but also see if I could align them with some of the design philosophies of the factions themselves, and this was the result. Let me know what you think?

DISCLAIMER: I used Dall-E/Bing's AI for the creation of these avatars.

SpoilerAvatars Showcase

Project TAILS 1.0

Project TAILS Heavy Metal Edition

[close]

I'll keep updating the mod pack over time as I create new avatars - so let me know what species you want to see! I could maybe even create specific OCs, I'm pretty good at getting Bing to spit out what I want, but you'd have to be very specific in order for me to get a good idea for a prompt.

Now updated for version 0.98a, and presenting the addition of the "Heavy Metal" pack!

This of course is not even close to canon for some of the factions, but as a high-tech enthusiast, I thought that all the factions deserved a bit of an armor upgrade. Decided to give them power armor and high-tech headwear. More to come!

Sorry this took so long - Bing has basically completely locked me out - can hardly do anything that I want to with it now...I've still got some saved stuff that I plan on adding as time goes on, but anything that's even anywhere

close

to copyrighted material (apparently smooth power armor reads too close to Halo and Iron Man) gets failed...so I learned ComfyUI and built my own AI server. Which means I can gen literally anything I want, now! Could be interesting... ;)
